identity.mission: Create a fintech experience that feels like a high-end command center, not a spreadsheet. Use deep immersion, tactical precision, and 'The Tracing Beam' aesthetic.
design_principles: Fusion: Military HUD precision mixed with Swiss typographic discipline
Emotion: Trust comes from clarity and solidity
Content: Data is the art; frame it beautifully
Negative Space: Luxury is the absence of clutter
Contrast: High-visibility Emerald against Deep Void Navy

rules.headings: Use 'Outfit' with tight tracking (-0.02em). Weight 600-800 for heroes, 500 for section titles.
rules.body: Use 'DM Sans' for all UI text. High legibility. Weight 400 for text, 500 for labels.
rules.numbers: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for tabular financial data and transaction IDs for perfect alignment.

shadcn_customization.general: Strip default borders. Use 'bg-slate-900' with 'border-slate-800'. Add subtle inner glow 'inset-0 ring-1 ring-white/5'.
shadcn_customization.card: Use 'Card' component but apply 'bg-slate-950/50 backdrop-blur-md border-slate-800' for glass effect.
shadcn_customization.button: Primary buttons: 'bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white font-medium tracking-wide shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)]'.
shadcn_customization.input: bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-800 focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500/50 placeholder:text-slate-600
shadcn_customization.table: Header: 'bg-slate-900/50 text-slate-400 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider'. Rows: 'hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors'.

BalanceCard.style: The 'Tracing Beam' Effect. Dark gradient background. On hover, a subtle emerald border glow travels around the card.
BalanceCard.content: Large geometric font for amount. Small trend indicator (+2.4%) in green/red pill.

TransactionRow.style: Minimalist. Icon on left (rounded square), Title top, Date bottom. Amount on right aligned. Status as a colored dot.

surfaces: Tactile: bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-800 to-slate-900 border border-slate-700
decorations: Noise Overlay: Add a fixed 'opacity-[0.03]' noise texture over the entire app to kill digital flatness.
Glow Orbs: Place 'blur-[100px]' emerald or cyan orbs behind major sections (like Hero or Total Balance).

patterns: Stagger Children: Parent container staggers children by 0.05s.
Slide Up Fade: Initial state { y: 20, opacity: 0 } -> { y: 0, opacity: 1 }.
Scale Tap: Active elements scale to 0.98 on press.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: 1. Import fonts in index.css. 2. Configure tailwind colors/fontFamily. 3. Update 'radius' in index.css to 0.75rem. 4. Install framer-motion, lucide-react, recharts.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical: Do NOT use default shadcn styles. Override them with the Dark Executive theme. Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 contrast against the dark navy background.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts. Style the tooltip to be a glassmorphic card. Remove grid lines or make them very subtle (slate-800/20).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use Bento Grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition 'transition: all'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (pill or sharp) with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Do not use placeholders.
